en: A monochrome photograph showing a group of people posing formally outdoors, most of whom are dressed in early 20th century military uniforms, while a few women and men in civilian attire stand at the center. Behind them, there is an ornate iron fence and large columns, with trees and a multi-story building featuring balconies in the background. Visible signage says 'St. Marquar...' suggesting possible Germanic or Central European language influence.
